diagnosis: Customer removed 30 seats mid-cycle on the 3rd but invoice INV-88410 still shows old count. According to KB-0011, seat removals take effect at next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle, so the invoice is likely correct. Customer expects a $1,200 credit, but policy does not allow it.
reply: I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist. Regarding your invoice INV-88410: seat removals take effect at the next renewal period and are not credited mid-cycle, so the current invoice correctly reflects the seat count before the change. For details, see our article on seat count changes (kb-0011). We understand this may be unexpected and our specialist team will review your account further.
